text: The source-test job invokes commlint -l clang-format and fetches clang-tidy. Its configuration uses commlint:lint_wrapper with wraps: clang-format:lint. The local wrapper applies exclusions/support paths before delegating. This replaces the dedicated shell task and its diff-size exit check; it does not establish unchanged upstream behavior or a successful lint run.
title: Thunderbird clang-format CI delegates through the commlint linter wrapper
